findings.question: 사동 접미사('-이/히/리/기/우/구/추-')가 쓰인 사동사는? => 먹이다
findings.evidence: Distractor '보이다' is also a causative verb formed with -이- (보다 -> 보이다, 'to show', e.g. '친구에게 사진을 보였어요'); it is a valid answer alongside '먹이다'. The prompt does not restrict to one sense, and the hint 'the form that makes someone eat' only works by leaking the answer. (Identical item appears under 8 example_ids: bk-ko-k8-k-k8-honorific_subj-002, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-honorific_obj-002, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-passive_affix-002, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-passive_compound-002, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-causative_affix-002, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-causative_compound-002, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-formal_style-002, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-modesty-002.)
findings.suggestion: Replace '보이다' with a verb that is only passive or neither (e.g. '쓰이다'-passive, '닫히다', '열리다') and replace '먹히다'/'잡히다' only if checked against dictionary: keep clearly passive-only verbs.

findings.question: 사동 접미사('-이/히/리/기/우/구/추-')가 쓰인 사동사는? => 먹이다
findings.evidence: Hint 1 '남에게 먹게 만드는 사동 표현입니다' describes only '먹이다' by name of the verb root, revealing the answer. (Identical item appears under 8 example_ids: bk-ko-k8-k-k8-honorific_subj-002, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-honorific_obj-002, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-passive_affix-002, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-passive_compound-002, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-causative_affix-002, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-causative_compound-002, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-formal_style-002, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-modesty-002.)
findings.suggestion: Hint should explain 사동 (주어가 다른 대상에게 동작을 하게 함) without naming 먹다.

findings.question: 객체 높임 특수어휘 '드리다'가 바르게 쓰인 문장은? => 할아버지께 선물을 드렸습니다.
findings.evidence: The prompt names '드리다'; two distractors ('할아버지가 선물을 주셨습니다', and '선생님이 책을 드렸습니다' with subject 선생님이) are structurally off, and the first contains no '드리다' at all, so it can be eliminated without knowing the grammar. '친구에게 선물을 드렸습니다' is also not unambiguously wrong in everyday speech (some speakers use 드리다 to anyone politely). (Identical item appears under 8 example_ids: bk-ko-k8-k-k8-honorific_subj-003, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-honorific_obj-003, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-passive_affix-003, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-passive_compound-003, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-causative_affix-003, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-causative_compound-003, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-formal_style-003, bk-ko-k8-k-k8-modesty-003.)
findings.suggestion: Make every option contain '드리다'/'주다' in parallel frames, and make the wrong option about a clearly non-honorable recipient with a different error type (e.g. '동생에게 선물을 드렸습니다').

findings.question: 평서문 간접화법('-다고 하다')이 바르게 쓰인 문장은? => 민수가 내일 고향에 간다고 했어요.
findings.evidence: The prompt gives the target ending '-다고 하다', and hint 2 lists '-냐고/-라고/-자고', so matching the surface ending ('간다고') solves it with no knowledge needed. findings.suggestion: Drop the parenthetical '-다고 하다' from the prompt and the hint list; ask 'Which sentence correctly reports a statement?'

findings.question: 비례나 정도의 심화를 나타내는 연결어미는? => -ㄹ수록
findings.evidence: Hint 2 'the more... the more...' plus the prompt wording '비례' makes '-ㄹ수록' the only plausible option; also answer is written '-ㄹ수록' while explanation uses standard '-(으)ㄹ수록' (inconsistent notation, and '-ㄹ 걸' / '-ㄹ 뿐' similarly drop '(으)'). findings.question: '오후 3시 30분'의 올바른 우리말 시각 표현은? => 오후 세 시 반
findings.evidence: Hint 1 says '시간은 고유어 수사, 분은 한자어 수사' but means 시(hour), not 시간(duration); distractor '오후 삼 시 삼십분' also uses inconsistent spacing ('삼십분'). Distractor '오전 세 시 서른' contradicts '오후' in the prompt, so it is trivially eliminable. The explanation also accepts '세 시 삼십 분' which is fine but not listed. (Identical item appears under 9 example_ids: bk-ko-k5-k-k5-time-003, bk-ko-k5-k-k5-past-003, bk-ko-k5-k-k5-plans-003, bk-ko-k5-k-k5-weekdays-003, bk-ko-k5-k-k5-months-003, bk-ko-k5-k-k5-clock-003, bk-ko-k5-k-k5-frequency-003, bk-ko-k5-k-k5-past2-003, bk-ko-k5-k-k5-birthday-003.)
findings.suggestion: Change hint to '시(hour)는 고유어 수사, 분은 한자어 수사'; replace '오전 세 시 서른' with e.g. '오후 세 시 삼십 번'-type error not contradicting the prompt (or '오후 셋 시 삼십 분').

findings.question: 요일 중 수요일 다음 날을 가리키는 요일은? => 목요일

findings.question: 다음 중 음식을 나타내는 낱말이 아닌 것은? => 도서관

findings.question: 물건 가격을 물어보는 올바른 표현은? => 이 사과 얼마예요?
